name: Seru Artisan’s Crescent
description: The Artisan’s Crescent is Sanctus Seru’s district for doctrine-approved craftsmanship. Purity-screened workshops, resonance-aligned studios, decree-regulated artisan guilds, and Praetorian oversight define this crescent-shaped enclave. All art, craft, and fabrication must comply with the Tribunal’s doctrine, ensuring purity and order in every creation.
